mechanism: Levonorgestrel may increase serotonin activity and rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist, creating potential for additive serotonergic effects; additionally, oral contraceptives can affect rizatriptan metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); consider alternative triptan or non-hormonal contraception if symptoms emerge; no dose adjustment typically required for routine use.
